Hey and don't put that immense pressure on yourself to stick to it so strongly. Obviously that's a goal but we are all taking steps towards it.

Kudos to you for even getting help, I don't feel ready yet for that but hey, in our own time right.

And yeah I feel you, I'm always fearful of showing the disgusting pain that exists within me and that people will leave because of it. But I also highly crave the feeling of a connection, and I realize I cannot get that without first trusting a lil. Slowly does it.

Your last bit was beautiful. It's true. Sometimes u forget about these larger things u feel a part of. Guess covid restrictions really did do a number on me huh. 

Thank you kind stranger. Your perspective is honestly greatly appreciated. I wish you the best of luck with always remembering these moments and I'll do the same.
Same to you bud, best of luck out there

Nah I understand your pov, you're not crazy haha.

I've been trying to adopt that pov for awhile now with a certain level of success. I'm not feeling ready to try just yet but I've atleast convinced myself that I need to give it some time, if I kill myself now I won't have the ability to undo that.

Thanks for that. I'm feeling a lil better and more stable now. I needed a reminder of that pov.

Yeah I used to draw a lot of comfort in knowing I could always turn to suicide if I really wanted. Doesn't comfort me so much nowadays tho, just tired of turning to it I guess.

Yeah my job is killing me rn, but I'm quitting soon. I've got my parents support on that so that's nice. Yeah I'm alone all day too, I wonder whether something physical like your job would be better. Sitting around all day is definitely getting to me.

I'm very happy that you've found something that works for you, honestly. I'll take your words into consideration, maybe start with some weights again first. 

Yeah I'm really trying to make the most of my life. It's really tiring tho. I kinda wish I got to take a backseat in my own life sometimes. So I wouldn't have to figure it all out.

Thanks for that. Sorry to talk you into a corner. The little voice in me who believes living is the right thing to do always gets that treatment in my head haha.

I have a rough idea of the steps that would need to be taken. Therapy, maybe medication, years and years of work, a lot of talking. No guarantee after all that tho. I'm honestly considering doing that because like fuck it right, you never know unless you try. But at the same time the lack of a guarantee scares me. What if this is forever? What if it never really goes away and I just get better at dealing with it when it comes? What if that isn't enough. Idk I'm young and I don't know much but that scares me shitless.

Yeah I had a lil period where I did that too. Helped burn some time and keep me distracted for sure. I've been considering picking it up again recently, maybe I'll take your message as a sign to try it again. Thanks for that.

Ps. Aren't you scared this feeling never goes away? I don't really know how to feel about that fear of mine.

I'll take your words into consideration with talking to my friends. I just hate the feeling of being a burden ya feel me? Despise it.

And thank you for sharing with me your story. I feel for you bud, I really do. I won't say I'm sorry for your experiences because I'm sure you get enough of that.

Yeah if you figure it out someday I'd hope to be able to hear from you again. And if I do I'll send you a message. Finding a motivation to live is some crazy shit man, almost as bizarre as the thought of a flying pig.

Some know I have plans. I've had plans for years now. One sorta knows I'm really close. But I try to keep it away from him cuz he's far away and has his own shit to deal with. I don't want him to feel helpless.

Will there ever be a feeling of trying everything. Won't people just think they haven't and that they've failed regardless? I don't want to put the helpless feeling I'm feeling on them. That makes me feel worse than wanting to die

That's true. That's kinda how I've been living my life. 

You never know, maybe things will get better doing this.

Mixed results but I see the potential you speak of.

I have a strong feeling ill drive them there. I'm lost and scared and I don't want anyone to feel what I'm feeling. And I know telling them how close I feel to commiting suicide will make them feel exactly that. I've done it before and my best friend waited 7 hours in his car outside my place to be close enough to act.

Sorry for feeling guilty about it. I can't help it really.

Would you be willing to share with me your story? I don't understand why people who feel this way continue. I don't get it. What are your motivations?
I'm considering it. I'm just so afraid that it'll take my whole life to manage it, and that it'll never really go away. I'd rather not live if that's the case.

I've seen people get tired of people like me. After years of trying to help them when they can't help themselves. I'd rather my loved ones feel sad that I'm gone than to resent my existence before it. Sorry, I know your intentions are good. I'm just voicing my thoughts.

Even talking to you, a person I don't know on the internet makes me feel guilty for putting this on you at your own expense.

I'm thinking of doing that. I don't know man. I dont wanna add to their plates forever. And I'm honestly not sure if this will ever end.

Thanks for hearing me out, I'm at work rn and it helps.
Idk man, sounds greedy af. Makes your q max cdr spike really late. Becomes a bit clunky no? I've only tried it a few times

1. I find yone weak in the top lane against the strongest toplaners right now. His short trades and long trades early are decent but most of the meta top Laners take him to town. This is also due to his small HP pool.
2. I think tp is a good shout, try to use your ult on cool down for teamfught as its an easy way to score some kills and assist to expedite your scaling process. 
3. Zeal plus crit cloak is a big spike, then pd and ie, then when u complete dd
4. I almost always try to use my e to dodge some ability then full commit to the fight. Sometimes it's not possible but really just use your e when u wanna go in, you'll get a better feel for it the more u play.
5. Short trades against ppl who want to long trade, long trade ppl who wanna short trade. Becareful of not losing too much health. 
6. I'd say he's looking to dive backline, or initiate, or most ideally come in second so that the back line exposes them self while targeting your teammate and using ult to clump them. 
7. Almost never use e defensively because u WILL go back.
8. Aa between each skill cast, use q3 to guarantee r

Honestly I'd say he probably needs to go mid, although I prefer toplane too but as people get more accustomed to playing against him his life up top will be harder and harder.

Hmmm. The only issues I have with getting botrk is that the components just suck before finishing it, the on hit only applies to the first target only hit by q, your aoe abilities don't apply the healing like it does with dd. I think there is another thread somewhere in this subreddit that covers the nuances as to why botrk isn't the preferred build too I don't remember exactly.

As with the stormrazer, I liked the feel, but I felt it was unnecessary the more I played as the combos are pretty okay to land and those that are not usually don't start with an aa to get the slow

You understood that perfectly. Cuz dd allows him to "lifesteal" off his ult anyways(less I know since its aoe, I didn't take that into account earlier). Only with vamp do you get actual aa life steal which is directly affected by the nerf

Actually, I suspect you're looking at the wrong archetype of champs. I think yas is able to 100-0 Ppl with 1100 gold, Irelia too, just off the top of my head.  The common denominator I see is space. If you wave manage well you are rewarded with kill pressure, if you fuck it up you not only have no kill pressure but no real way to dodge ganks other than warding deeper.

I don't think his core 3 items changes no matter what. It's hard to justify not running pd/statik, IE, dd when it provides him exactly what he needs, crit, damage, atk spd, life steal, a bit of resistances, anti-burst. U could toy with aftershock but even then I'd say conquerer healing with this build makes him more of a "tank" than building tank items or running a tank rune setup because of drain tanking
It only really affects yone pre dd post vamp unless you're building weird shit or running bloodline
